senses.gloss: m.(b. h. חֹמֶשׁ; חמש)one fifth, esp. one fifth of the value to be added as fine on restoring misappropriated property or redeeming dedicated property (Lev. V, 16; 24; XXVII, 27).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 54a:10">B. Mets. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>חוֹמְשׁוֹ של קרן</he> the fifth part of the principal (assessed value), i.e. one plus one fifth, v. <cite ref="H00398">next w.</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: Ḥomesh, one of the five books of Moses, also one of the five books of Psalms.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 36b:1">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ הפיקודים</he> the Book of Numbers; <he>ח׳ שני</he> the Book of Exodus; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוֹמָשִׁים</he>, <he>חוֹמָשִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:8">B. Mets. VI, 8</cite> <he>חמשה ח׳ הן</he> there are five things to which the law ordaining the addition of one fifth applies.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:11">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>חמשה חוֹמְשֵׁי תורה</he> the five books of the Law.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:1:10">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite> top <he>ח׳</he> single parts of the Pentateuch.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:6">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>שני ח׳</he> two books of the Psalms.
